scripts.clean:metro: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const paths=['node_modules/.cache','.expo'];for(const p of paths){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}catch{}}console.log('Cleared Metro/Expo caches:',paths.join(', '));"
scripts.android:aab: node scripts/bump-version.js && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/copy-release-mapping.js
scripts.android:aab:WithoutVersion: cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/copy-release-mapping.js
scripts.deep-clean-rebuild:android: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('android/build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cd android && gradlew.bat --stop && cd .. && npx expo prebuild --platform android
scripts.android:embed:JsBundle: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build/res',{recursive:true})" && expo export:embed --platform android --dev false --bundle-output build/index.android.bundle --assets-dest build/res
